name: Miranda
source:
MIRANDA is the story of a girl named Miranda who finds herself in a strange new town. Depending on the friends she makes, she remembers and recounts her stories differently. Her past is shrouded with mystery – does she escape her abusive past, or is it inevitable that it consumes her?

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/rpg/miranda/25230/]Game Jolt[/url]]
